Title: Mordred chemical descriptors
Description: Computes 1,458 molecular descriptors with Mordred, spanning constitutional counts, topological and connectivity indices, autocorrelations, charge and surface area terms. Moriwaki and colleagues wrote it as an open successor to earlier descriptor packages, prioritising breadth of coverage and the ability to handle large molecules that older tools rejected. Values follow deterministically from the structure, so they are reproducible, though many descriptors are strongly correlated and some are undefined for particular structures.
Interpretation: 1458 Mordred molecular descriptors computed deterministically from structure.
